description: This file provides common utility functions, exception classes, and base class for managing OpenAI API interactions, including client caching, error handling, and SSL configuration within a larger machine learning or API client project.

classes.name: OpenAIError
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors returned from OpenAI API interactions, encapsulating HTTP status, request, response, headers, and body details.

classes.name: BaseOpenAILLM
classes.description: Abstract base class providing methods for caching and initializing OpenAI clients, and retrieving SSL configurations.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] drop_params_from_unprocessable_entity_error( e: Union[openai.UnprocessableEntityError, httpx.HTTPStatusError], data: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Processes an OpenAI or httpx error to identify invalid parameters and remove them from the original data dictionary.

methods.name: Optional[Union[OpenAI,AsyncOpenAI,AzureOpenAI,AsyncAzureOpenAI]] get_cached_openai_client( client_initialization_params: dict, client_type: Literal["openai", "azure"] )
methods.description: Retrieves a cached OpenAI or AzureOpenAI client based on initialization parameters.

methods.name: set_cached_openai_client( openai_client: Union[OpenAI, AsyncOpenAI, AzureOpenAI, AsyncAzureOpenAI], client_type: Literal["openai", "azure"], client_initialization_params: dict, )
methods.description: Stores an OpenAI or AzureOpenAI client instance in the in-memory cache with a default TTL.

methods.name: str get_openai_client_cache_key( client_initialization_params: dict, client_type: Literal["openai", "azure"] )
methods.description: Creates a unique cache key for an OpenAI client based on its initialization parameters, hashing the API key if present.

methods.name: List[str] get_openai_client_initialization_param_fields( client_type: Literal["openai", "azure"] )
methods.description: Returns a list of parameter names needed to initialize OpenAI or AzureOpenAI client, excluding 'self'.

methods.name: Optional[httpx.AsyncClient] _get_async_http_client( shared_session: Optional["ClientSession"] = None, )
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a shared asynchronous HTTPX client configured with SSL settings.

methods.name: Optional[httpx.Client] _get_sync_http_client()
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a shared synchronous HTTPX client configured with SSL settings.
